title: Register produce-critique-refine as a reusable recipe contract
narrative: Reusable subgraphs need typed inputs/outputs, applicability predicates, budgets, and traceable outcomes. Independent review and verify-repair already ship (`fangore_insp_independent_review`, `fangore_verify_repair_recipe`). Produce-critique-refine now ships as its own recipe; an optional three-round council with recorded dissent remains unshipped and non-default. Tracks MH-PA-03[^insp-pa-03].
implementation: Agentic Recipe `produce_critique_refine` (`ProduceCritiqueRefineTemplate`) builds produce → isolated critique → bounded refine (repeating + StopContract) → complete. Soft points bind runner kinds, `critique_prompt`, `max_rounds`, critic isolation, and acceptance; `critique_prompt` and `max_rounds` are evolvable. Node components: `soft_point` per declared slot on the node that exposes it, plus `stop_contract` on `refine`. Registered in the default catalog.
validation: Harness `graph_recipes` op `produce_critique_refine_recipe`. Hard expects template stamp, node ids, an isolated critic, refine bounded by `max_rounds`, node components attached to the right parents, and the evolvable allowlist.
